summary: FD_ED_TC_02_Identification | Aeroplan Login | OTP Bypassed | AC Wallet | Eligible | APPR EL-01
title: Identification | Aeroplan Login | OTP Bypassed | AC Wallet | Eligible | APPR EL-01
description:
Validates that when a customer is logged into their Aeroplan profile, the system bypasses OTP authentication entirely and proceeds directly to passenger selection. Also tests AC Wallet payout since customer has active Aeroplan.

Prerequisites:
Customer logged into Aeroplan profile (session active); Aeroplan #: 1234567890; PNR: TCED02; 1 leg AC (YYZ?YVR); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42; APPR; Aeroplan account active (not frozen)
